solutions.title: All triples
solutions.strategy: Check every triple and keep the sum with the smallest absolute difference to target.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every combination of three indices can be evaluated.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the best sum and loop counters are stored.

solutions.title: Sort and two pointers
solutions.strategy: Fix one value, then move two pointers inward to approach the target.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting costs O(n log n), then each fixed index runs a linear two-pointer scan.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Sorting may use recursion stack space.
